commands.name: duckherd
commands.description: Duckherd mode: plan a task and run it with helpers
commands.output: The lead duck is ready. Give me a task.

commands.name: helpers
commands.description: Pick the model for helpers, or let the lead duck pick per helper
commands.output: Helpers run on the model the lead duck picks. Pick one: /helpers haiku, sonnet, opus, or auto (the lead duck picks per helper).

commands.name: learn
commands.description: Explain what we just did and save it to your learning log

commands.name: tell
commands.description: Send a message to a running helper
commands.output: Type /tell, the helper's name and your message, like /tell Pip check the tests too.

commands.name: helper-stop
commands.description: Stop a running helper by name
commands.output: Type /helper-stop and the helper's name, like /helper-stop Pip.

commands.name: crew
commands.description: The ducks: sounds on, quiet or off; calm or lively; pictures or text
commands.argumentHint: on | quiet | off | calm | lively | pictures | text | theme <name>
commands.output: The ducks: sounds on, lively, drawn as pictures. /crew on|quiet|off, calm|lively, pictures|text.

commands.name: keep-warm
commands.description: Ping the session just before its prompt cache goes cold (auto: only during a big unfinished plan)
commands.output: Keep-warm is auto: pings go only while a plan is unfinished and the context is 100k or more, about 3 minutes before the cache goes cold (TTL 1h), and stop after 3 hours without you typing.

commands.name: handoff
commands.description: Haiku writes HANDOFF.md so a fresh chat can carry on this work
commands.output: Haiku is writing the handoff file…

commands.name: chat-effort
commands.description: The lead duck's own effort: auto judges each prompt, off leaves it, or pin a level
commands.argumentHint: auto | off | low | medium | high | xhigh | max

commands.name: throttle
commands.description: Usage throttle: show it, or set on, off or boost (off until the current windows reset)
commands.output:
Throttle on.
5-hour: 31% used
Weekly: no reading (no reset time: no pace check)
Level 0 (no window is tight)
/throttle on | off | boost

tools.name: plan
tools.description: Duckherd mode only. Show the plan for the current task in the person's panel. Call it before starting and again when a step changes state. Several steps can be doing at once.

tools.name: handoff
tools.description: Write a ready-to-paste prompt for another of the person's sessions (a branch that session owns). It is saved as a draft in the Sessions tab; the person reads it and sends it. Never send it yourself.

tools.name: lesson
tools.description: Save a plain-English explanation of what we did, and 1 or 2 lessons, to the person's learning log. Call it when a task is done, or when they type /learn.
